name: Assamite Sorcery Rituals — Basic — Eye of the Translator

system.description:
Many viziers study the rudiments of Thaumaturgy in order to work this ritual, which is modest in physical power but immensely useful to a scholar. It does not alter the page it is cast upon, but conjures the illusion of its writing flowing into a form the caster recognizes.

System: The sorcerer cuts his brow and lets three drops of blood fall onto the page (at no cost in Blood Traits or health), then meditates for ten minutes as the blood soaks in and vanishes. He gains a bonus on all rolls to translate, decode or comprehend that specific page or surface, lost if he breaks off study for more than ten minutes or when the night ends. The ritual must be repeated separately for each page or surface to be understood.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two: Saracens
